chunks: The best course a person may adopt regarding lost property, when he finds it, is not to take it and not to expose himself to it. If people were to leave what they find, its owner would come and take it.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: the best or most preferable course
key_terms.اَللُّقَطَةِ: lost property that is found by someone
key_terms.يَتَعَرَّضَ: to interfere with or involve oneself with it

ai.seo_question: What is the best thing to do when someone finds lost property in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the best practice regarding lost property is to leave it untouched rather than take possession of it. It emphasizes safeguarding the rights of others and avoiding unnecessary involvement in property that belongs to someone else.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4064 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"The best approach for a person regarding lost property (luqata) when they find it is to leave it and not touch it. If people were to leave what they find, its owner would eventually come and take it."
